review.notes: Full read of all OCR lines against extracted text from all 7 physical PDF pages plus structure check (no code fences; heading set matches the printed card). Dropped content found and restored: the 'OpenAI' wordmark line of the cover (the 'GPT-Live' wordmark itself is the embedded image), the entire body of footnote 1 on physical p.3 (its inline $^{1}$ marker survives in the OCR), and the 'OpenAI' line itself. Tables 1, 2 and 4 were compared value by value against the PDF text layer and all values match; the appendix tables were additionally verified on the rendered physical p.7 at 300 dpi, which also confirmed that Table 3's last two header cells are mis-split in the OCR ('GPT-Live-1 mini GPT-Live-1 mini Previously reported' / 'Corrected' instead of 'GPT-Live-1 mini Previously reported' / 'GPT-Live-1 mini Corrected'). No other numeric discrepancies.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.1 cover prints four lines: 'OpenAI' wordmark, the 'GPT-Live' wordmark (which is the embedded image), 'System Card', and '2026-07-08' (visually verified at 110 dpi). OCR kept the image, 'System Card' and the date but dropped the 'OpenAI' wordmark line; the patch restores it above the wordmark image in printed order.

patches.evidence: Physical p.3 prints the full footnote 1 at the bottom of the page ('1 GPT-Live-1 and GPT-Live-1 mini are intended to be used in accordance with OpenAI's Usage Policies, Service Terms, and Terms of Use. ... can be found here.'); OCR kept the inline $^{1}$ marker after '...published at launch for those models.' but dropped the whole footnote body. The patch restores it directly after the marked sentence, before the printed '3 Model Safety' heading; the printed line-break inside 'usage-policies/' is joined.

Rendered physical p.7 (300 dpi) shows the Table 3 header as six labelled columns: 'GPT-Live-1 Previously reported', 'GPT-Live-1 Corrected', 'GPT-Live-1 mini Previously reported', 'GPT-Live-1 mini Corrected' (matching Table 4's header, which OCR transcribed correctly). OCR duplicated 'GPT-Live-1 mini' into the fifth header cell and dropped it from the sixth. All Table 3 body values were visually verified against the same render and match the OCR.
